proposals.evidence: Turner’s bhagna branch explicitly gives Hindi bhāgnā and neighboring g-retaining run verbs. These whole imperatives are bhāg + jā “run away”, with yāti as the go auxiliary; the ordered components distinguish this g-stem from the bhajj- branch. The segmentation is inferred from the complete modern expression, without adding a claim about its regional borrowing route.

Both components are included in order; the source ɛ vowel is retained and the link does not treat the full predicate as one inherited stem.
